Company Overview:

PartsBase Inc. is the world's largest online Aviation Marketplace and Community. Our global community is comprised of over 6,500 companies accessing our technology in over 140+ countries & territories. We work with some of the biggest brands in aviation including Delta, Northrop Gruman, AvAir, Heico, Chevron, Air France Industries, and Air Australia.

PartsBase offers a FULLY remote environment where one can work at the forefront of where the aviation business meets technology. Imagine getting to work with peers worldwide, implementing business technology projects that challenge the boundaries.

Life at PartsBase:

One of the top benefits of working at PartsBase is the culture. We are a TEAM-focused organization, and everyone celebrates each other's successes. Our inclusive culture welcomes all employees and values their unique contributions to our success. Our clients tell us time and time again that our people set us apart from the competition. We naturally strive to hire the very best talent. The ideal candidate is a motivated, well-organized individual who has a deep understanding of prospecting and developing strong relationships with customers.

About the Role

PartsBase is looking for an AI Design Engineer to help our design team work faster and smarter with AI. This hands-on role sits between design, engineering, and training. You will own how designers and non-technical stakeholders use AI, and connect our design tools to APIs, MCPs, and agents to remove manual steps. Success means people adopt these tools with confidence, and the team knows when automation fits a problem and when design judgment must stay in the loop.

What You Will Do

• Connect design tools with APIs, MCPs, and agents to cut manual steps in the design process.

• Prototype in code (React, HTML, and CSS) using tools such as Claude Code and Cursor.

• Teach designers and non-technical stakeholders in plain language, and drive adoption of design tools.

• Judge when a design problem suits automation and when it needs design judgment in the loop.

• Own the central library of reusable skills and workflows, with clear documentation.

• Gather feedback, improve what works, and retire what does not.

• Track how often shared skills and workflows are used and which manual steps they remove, and report results on a regular cadence.

• Set quality checks for AI output and define standards the team follows.

• Mentor designers and help shape the team's AI roadmap and tooling budget.

What We Are Looking For

• 4+ years in design technology, UX engineering, or design systems.

• A design background, with a portfolio showing real UX, product, or visual design work and sound design judgment.

• Hands-on, daily use of AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, or Cursor, including building skills or agents.

• Fluency in Figma and front-end skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or React.

• Experience with design systems, components, or design tokens.

• Ability to connect tools through APIs and automation or integration platforms; familiarity with MCP servers.

• Strength at explaining technical ideas to non-technical people, and at running workshops, demos, or office hours that change habits.

• A track record of building internal tools, plugins, or workflows that other people actually adopted.

• Sound judgment about when automation helps and when it does not.

Nice to Have

• Figma plugins, variables, or the Figma API.

• Storybook or a component library.

• Workflow automation tools such as Zapier, n8n, or Make.

• Scripting or Node experience for design automation.

• Background in B2B marketplaces, aviation, or aerospace (a plus, not a requirement).

Who Thrives Here

Builders who enjoy making tools other people use. Patient, clear teachers. People curious about how designers work and where AI genuinely helps, who earn trust from designers and non-

Work Environment

This is a full-time, fully remote role. You will work closely every day with our finance team, leadership team, and the people building and operating the business, staying connected through video meetings, messaging, and shared collaboration tools. We value a remote-first culture built on clear communication, responsiveness, and accountability, with availability during core Eastern Time business hours.

PartsBase is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at all levels of the organization
